Let \(d_i=a_i-a_{i+1}\) for \(i=1,\dots,99\), and \(d_{100}=a_{100}-a_1\).  
The inequalities become
\[
d_i \ge 2021 d_{i+1}\quad (i=1,\dots,100,\ d_{101}=d_1).
\]
Iterating around the cycle gives
\[
d_i \ge 2021^{100} d_i.
\]
Since \(2021^{100}>1\), this implies \(d_i\le 0\) for all \(i\).  
But
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{100} d_i=(a_1-a_2)+(a_2-a_3)+\cdots+(a_{100}-a_1)=0.
\]
Thus all \(d_i=0\), so all \(a_i\) are equal. Since \(a_{10}=10\), we get \(a_{22}=10\).

\[
\boxed{10}
\]
